items.text: Lighten one another's burdens through mutual help, and keep constant and faithful love.
items.quote: by their lightening each other's burdens through mutual help; by constant and faithful love

items.text: Have all your possessions in common.
items.quote: by having all their possessions in common

items.text: Be open to the propagation of the human race, for which marriage was instituted.
items.quote: Not only, in strict truth, was marriage instituted for the propagation of the human race

items.text: Secure the holy education of your children.
items.quote: to secure the holy education of children

items.text: Temper your authority over your children by the example of divine authority.
items.quote: to temper the authority of the father by the example of the divine authority

items.text: Obey your parents.
items.quote: render children obedient to their parents

items.text: Obey your master.
items.quote: servants obedient to their masters

items.text: Bear the mutual services and duties of marriage, and do not seek to loosen the marriage tie.
items.quote: the mutual services and duties of marriage seem almost unbearable; and thus very many yearn for the loosening of the tie

items.text: Cleave to your wife, for two shall become one flesh.
items.quote: For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife, and they two shall be in one flesh.

items.text: Let no one dissolve the marriage bond that God has joined.
items.quote: What, therefore, God bath joined together, let no man put asunder.

items.text: Have only one spouse; marriage is between one man and one woman.
items.quote: marriage, from its institution, should exist between two only, that is, between one man and one woman; that of two they are made, so to say, one flesh

items.text: Be fruitful, for through your union the human race is propagated and preserved.
items.quote: this husband and wife should be the natural beginning of the human race, from whom it might be propagated and preserved by an unfailing fruitfulness

items.text: Love your wife as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her.
items.quote: Eph.5:25-32 — Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church.

items.text: Submit to your own husband as to the Lord.
items.quote: Eph.5:23-24 — Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

items.text: Do not depart from your husband.
items.quote: 1 Cor. 7:10-11 — Let not the wife depart from her husband.

items.text: Do not put away your wife.
items.quote: 1 Cor. 7:10-11 — Let not the husband put away his wife.

items.text: Do not separate what God has joined together.
items.quote: Matt 19:5-6 — What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

items.text: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives.
items.quote: 1 Cor. 7:39 — The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth.

items.text: Do not provoke your children to wrath; bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
items.quote: Eph. 6:4 — Fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

items.text: Do not seek divorce; preserve the marriage bond.
items.quote: divorces are in the highest degree hostile to the prosperity of families and States

items.text: Maintain mutual kindness; do not let divorce weaken it.
items.quote: mutual kindness is weakened

items.text: Remain faithful; do not allow divorce to supply inducements to unfaithfulness.
items.quote: deplorable inducements to unfaithfulness are supplied

items.text: Protect the education and training of your children; do not break up the home.
items.quote: harm is done to the education and training of children; occasion is afforded for the breaking up of homes

items.text: Do not let divorce sow seeds of dissension among your families.
items.quote: the seeds of dissension are sown among families

items.text: Uphold her dignity; do not desert her after she has ministered to your pleasures.
items.quote: the dignity of womanhood is lessened and brought low, and women run the risk of being deserted after having ministered to the pleasures of men

items.text: Do not feign cruelty, violence, or adultery to obtain a divorce.
items.quote: by accusations of cruelty, violence, and adultery to feign grounds for the dissolution of the matrimonial bond

items.text: Spouses, know and understand that your marriage was instituted by God, raised by Christ to be a sacrament, and that a merely civil union is not a proper marriage.
items.quote: It is of the greatest consequence to husband and wife that all these things should be known and well understood by them

items.text: Spouses, conform to the laws of the State in the civil matters that spring from marriage, provided the Church does not object.
items.quote: they may conform to the laws of the State, if there be no objection on the part of the Church

items.text: Spouses, have no other wife or husband; marriage does not admit of plurality of wives or husbands.
items.quote: it does not admit of plurality of wives or husbands

items.text: Parents, guard the effects of marriage in every possible way and let no harm come to your children.
items.quote: for the Church wishes the effects of marriage to be guarded in all possible ways, and that no harm may come to the children

items.text: Do not practice polygamy; have only one spouse, for Christ condemned polygamy.
items.quote: Christ our Lord condemned the long-standing practice of polygamy and divorce

items.text: Do not divorce; keep the marriage bond unbroken, for Christ condemned divorce.
items.quote: Christ our Lord condemned the long-standing practice of polygamy and divorce

items.text: Do not marry a close blood relative; such incestuous marriages are not lawful.
items.quote: the Apostle Paul taught that divorces and incestuous marriages were not lawful

items.text: Cherish always very great mutual love, be faithful to your marriage vow, and give one another unfailing and unselfish help.
items.quote: cherish always very great mutual love, to be ever faithful to their marriage vow, and to give one another an unfailing and unselfish help

items.text: As head of your wife, command in heaven-born love, as Christ does the church.
items.quote: let there always be, both in him who commands and in her who obeys, a heaven-born love guiding both in their respective duties.

items.text: Be subject to your husband and obey him, not as a servant but as a companion, with honor and dignity.
items.quote: must be subject to her husband and obey him; not, indeed, as a servant, but as a companion, so that her obedience shall be wanting in neither honor nor dignity.

items.text: Do not inflict capital punishment on your wife for adultery.
items.quote: it was forbidden to the man to inflict capital punishment for adultery

items.text: Submit to your parents, obey them, and give them honor for conscience' sake.
items.quote: children, they ought to submit to the parents and obey them, and give them honor for conscience' sake

items.text: Give all care and watchful thought to the education and virtuous bringing up of your children; bring them up in the discipline and correction of the Lord.
items.quote: bring them up in the discipline and correction of the Lord.

items.text: Do not deprive your sons and daughters wishing to marry of their rightful freedom.
items.quote: sons and daughters, wishing to marry, are not in any way deprived of their rightful freedom

items.text: Do not marry within the degrees of consanguinity or affinity that the Church declares null.
items.quote: marriages within certain degrees of consanguinity or affinity to be null and void

items.text: Remain bound to your spouse until death; do not plan a second marriage while your first spouse lives.
items.quote: those husbands and wives are guilty of a manifest crime who plan... to be united in a second marriage before the first one has been ended by death.

items.text: If you must live apart, do not despair of reconciliation; seek reunion and accept the helps suited to your condition.
items.quote: she never ceases to endeavor to bring about a reconciliation, and never despairs of doing so.

items.text: Enter marriage with right ideas of its duties and noble purpose, not under mere passion, and do not anticipate it by sins.
items.quote: entertaining right ideas of the duties of marriage and of its noble purpose; neither... anticipate their marriage by a series of sins.

items.text: Bear tranquilly and even gladly the trials of marriage: one another's faults, differences of temper and character, and the cares of life.
items.quote: bear tranquilly and even gladly the trials of their state, such as, for instance, the faults that they discover in one another, the difference of temper and character.

items.text: Do not easily enter into marriage with those who are not Catholics, because it endangers faith and hinders the proper education of children.
items.quote: Care also must be taken that they do not easily enter into marriage with those who are not Catholics
items.conflict: Scripture forbids marriage to unbelievers (2 Cor 6:14), but not to fellow Christians outside the Roman Catholic communion (1 Cor 7:39).

items.text: Give your children a proper education in the faith, and do not allow a mixed marriage to hinder it.
items.quote: are a hindrance to the proper education of the children

items.text: Do not live together without lawful marriage; repent and enter into a lawful marriage.
items.quote: live wickedly together without the bond of lawful marriage... do penance; and... enter into a lawful marriage according to the Catholic rite.

items.text: Implore the help of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the apostles Peter and Paul, that they may show themselves your mother and helpers.
items.quote: implore the help of the Blessed and Immaculate Virgin Mary... ask the princes of the Apostles, Peter and Paul... to save the human race by their powerful patronage.
items.conflict: Prayer and worship belong to God alone (Matt 4:10); there is one mediator between God and men, Christ Jesus (1 Tim 2:5).
items.needs_role: Blessed Virgin Mary and Saints Peter and Paul

items.text: Do not dissolve the marriage union; keep it perpetual, for God has joined it.
items.quote: no one should dare to dissolve that union which God Himself had sanctioned by a bond perpetual.

items.text: Have only one wife, and do not take plural wives.
items.quote: condemning the customs of the Jews in their abuse of the plurality of wives.

items.text: Do not put away your wife except for fornication, and do not marry another; that is adultery.
items.quote: whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery.

items.text: Love your wife as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her; nourish and cherish her as your own body.
items.quote: Husbands, love your wives, as Christ also loved the Church, and delivered Himself up for it... So also ought men to love their wives as their own bodies.

items.text: Leave your father and mother and cleave to your wife, and be two in one flesh.
items.quote: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife, and they shall be two in one flesh.

items.text: Do not depart from your husband; if you do depart, remain unmarried or be reconciled to him, for you are bound to him as long as he lives.
items.quote: the wife depart not from her husband; and if she depart, that she remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband.

items.text: Bring up your children for the worship and religion of the true God and our Savior Jesus Christ.
items.quote: a people might be born and brought up for the worship and religion of the true God and our Saviour Jesus Christ.
